user.title: Create Combined Media Player
user.description: Drag to change the order. Top = highest priority. In the next step, optionally assign a control device to each source.

data_description.show_secondary: Show the first other playing source in the bottom-right of the media player's cover. The cover image entity remains unchanged.
data_description.hide_radio_station: Hide the station name in the album field when the content ID contains ://radio/. Other albums remain visible.
data_description.hold_seconds: Keep the previous display during brief playback gaps for 0–30 seconds. A higher-priority playing source wins immediately. Set 0 to disable.
data_description.sources: Select at least one source and drag the entries into the desired order.

missing_entities.title: Configured media entity is missing
missing_entities.description: These sources or control targets have neither a current state nor an entity registry entry: {entities}. Check the slots in integration options or restore the missing integration. The notice clears automatically when the entities exist again. Checking starts two minutes after Home Assistant has fully started.
